name: feedback-studio
description: Local visual feedback overlay for a site you're building or a Markdown file: click or select anything, leave typed or spoken feedback, then tell your coding agent 'PPF' (Please Process Feedback) to apply it. Zero-dependency Node + MCP server; also a Claude Code plugin.
author: Bastiaan Kortenbout <bastiaan@kb365.nl> (https://www.kb365.nl)

scripts.release:patch: npm version patch -m "release v%s" && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor -m "release v%s" && git push --follow-tags
scripts.release:major: npm version major -m "release v%s" && git push --follow-tags
